long_biography.plain_text:
Architecture has remained an operating tool for Cecil Chao, not merely a qualification. After studying at Durham University, he spent fourteen years in the Hong Kong Government Buildings Office, gaining experience in planning and land use. He then founded Cecil Chao & Associates, which became the in-house design practice for Cheuk Nang developments.

Chao continued to draw the main plans for new projects decades after moving into development. The practice has delivered more than three hundred projects, while Cheuk Nang's portfolio extends beyond Hong Kong to mainland China, Macau and Malaysia. Its work spans residential development, property investment and management.
